sentences.text: The United States uses IALA Region B, the buoyage system of the Americas, Japan, Korea and the Philippines.
It is built on one phrase: red, right, returning.

Returning means coming in from seaward, heading upstream, or, along the coast, traveling in the conventional direction, which runs clockwise around the country: south along the Atlantic coast, north up Florida’s Gulf coast, then west along the Gulf.
Red buoys are nuns, with pointed tops, and carry even numbers.
Green buoys are cans and carry odd numbers.
